prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified.  Clothes should use medieval simple round-neck or tie-neck wool cuts, NOT modern lapels, tailored suit coats or collared shirts. TWO rows TWO columns. TOP ARLO adult male local wool-washing waste-shift worker, sturdy middle-aged man with dark hair and stubble, faded blue-green round-neck tunic with brown work apron, tall plain work boots, bare empty hands, weary guarded expression. BOTTOM XIYOU adult woman downstream domestic water user and mother, mature face, dark hair tied in plain cream headscarf, dull rust-brown dress and olive shawl, holding one EMPTY ordinary wooden water pail, concerned firm stance. No children pictured, no drinking/testing unsafe water, no polluted backdrop, no judgement assigning collective migrant blame, no completed repair or apology. Their occupational props confer no safety certification.
